name: What are the signs that my roof needs to be replaced?
description: Signs your roof needs replacement include missing or cracked shingles, a sagging roof, leaks, and granule loss. Age (over 20-25 years) is also a key factor.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my roof needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common indicators that your roof may need replacement include missing or cracked shingles, a sagging roof deck, visible water damage or leaks inside your home, and granules from asphalt shingles collecting in gutters. If your roof is over 20-25 years old, even without obvious damage, it's worth having a professional inspection to assess its remaining lifespan and structural integrity. Early detection of issues can prevent more extensive and costly repairs down the line.
